kanban.comment: Read the kanban header and its body. Follows kanban.md#detection and common.md#leading-whitespace.

patterns.comment: Read a native percent comment at a line, header, shape or directive boundary, retaining directives in its padding and body. Follows kanban.md#comments and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.

`:::`: enters the class context. A class starts with `:::`. It takes the nonempty rest of its line segment as `class-text`, whitespace included. line = node data-block* | icon-line | class-line; icon and class lines start after indentation. Indentation counts every whitespace character other than a line feed once. Follows kanban.md#the-icon-and-class-contexts and kanban.md#units-and-contexts.
Read the icon opener as one keyword and its retained name as text, ending at the icon bracket. Follows kanban.md#the-icon-and-class-contexts.
Runs stop before separator-led common comments, and padding never consumes their separator. Follows kanban.md#the-icon-and-class-contexts and common.md#comment-lines.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

patterns.comment: An opener: `-)`, `(-`, `))`, `)`, `((`, `{{`, `(`, or `[`, tried in this order. It is an `opener` unit and enters the shape context. rule 3: A closer: `))`, `)`, `]`, `}}`, `(-`, `-)`, `((`, or `(`, tried in this order. It is a `closer` unit and leaves the shape context. Rule 4: A `shape-text` is one or more characters other than `)`, `]`, `(`, and `}`, as many as possible. Strings start only at a unit start, right after the opener; shape text keeps quotes after its first character and has no HTML rule. Follows kanban.md#the-statement-context and kanban.md#the-shape-context.
A quote and backtick start a markdown string, closed by backtick and quote. Follows kanban.md#the-shape-context.
A double quote starts a string ending at the next double quote, without escapes. Follows kanban.md#the-shape-context.
Read node text before a shape as its element name after indentation or a directive. Follows kanban.md#nodes-and-shapes and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
Read bare node text as its displayed label after indentation or a directive. Follows kanban.md#nodes-and-shapes and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.

kanban-shape-text.comment: Shape text takes as many characters other than ), ], (, and } as possible; quotes after its first character and percent pairs are text. Directives inside this text join its parts. Follows kanban.md#the-shape-context and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.

kanban-data-block.comment: Read a data block with an opaque unquoted text interior; double quotes protect braces without introducing a string scope. Follows kanban.md#the-data-context and kanban.md#data-blocks.
